<reason>PRO won a close clash by tying “traditional expectations” to the family-enforced wedding script couples actually face, not CON’s purified cheap core. CON’s pedigree and circularity hits were sharper, but CON already denied a duty to headcount, look, and pageant—the demands still arriving under tradition’s name—which is enough for the motion.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO turning CON’s “owe a mother a seat, not 200 plates” into the proposition: if the policed pageant is optional, obligation to lived traditional expectations has already shrunk.</best_rebuttal>
